method.works: One fresh load per row/cohort/device. Native CLS observed through font readiness (bounded 5s) plus 2s; home Pause and Play each one click, no tap timing.
method.speed: Three fresh phone loads per home/cohort, alternating A/B order. Native LCP observed through font readiness (bounded 5s) plus 5s; no wait for window load or video completion. Phone 390x844,80ms latency,1.6Mbps down,750Kbps up,4xCPU; cache disabled.
